summary:
Iter 212 DERIVED-PRICING + PRICE ALERTS + COMPETITOR WATCH + LEAD HISTORY verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. (A) /api/public/plans returns quarter = 3×monthly (1455→4365), annual = 10×monthly (14550), resto_annual = 10×resto_monthly (10000), resto_intl_quarter/annual = 3/10×resto_intl_monthly (135/450), intl_pro_annual = 10×intl_pro_monthly (450). Each derived plan carries derived_from + multiplier. pay_as_you_go_months == [3,6]. No *_half keys present. (B) PUT /api/super-admin/plans/annual {price:99999} → 400 with detail mentioning 'monthly'. PUT /super-admin/plans/monthly {price:1500} → 200 and public plans update to monthly 1500 / quarter 4500 / annual 15000; restored to 1455 (quarter 4365, annual 14550 verified). Same propagation + restore validated for resto_intl_monthly 50 → quarter 150 / annual 500 → restore to 45 (135/450). Unit: services.plans.apply_derived_prices({'monthly':{price:2000,…}, …}) → quarter 6000, annual 20000. email_service._resto_plan_rows() contains ₹1,000 + ₹10,000 + Monthly + Annual and NOT 12,000; restaurant_trial_reminder_email_html('X',3,'2026-10-10','trial',0) contains ₹10,000. (C) GET /super-admin/price-alerts/preview → 200 with campaign/rows/pending/already_sent — every row's annual_key ends '_annual' and annual_saving ≈ new_monthly*12 − new_annual (within 0.01); /sample → 200 html containing 'Switch to annual'; /api/public/renew/not-a-token → 404. NO POST /send performed. (D) GET /super-admin/competitor-watch → 200 (6 competitor rows). POST /competitor-watch/run → 200 in <60s, verdicts.salon.our_monthly == 19, verdicts.restaurant.our_monthly == 45, every row has source ∈ {live,benchmark} and lowest_monthly ≥ 9 (and ≥ 0.5×benchmark). (E) GET /super-admin/mira-leads/history → stale_days 15, total == salon.total + restaurant.total, country code lengths 2-3 with non-negative counters, every stale entry has days_silent ≥ 15. GET /super-admin/mira-leads/{id}/timeline → events sorted ascending by 'at' and first label starts with '🔎'. Regression: outreach report, auto-wa, tenant upgrade-quote (admin@miracurl.com / miracurl-marathahalli) → eligible true, new_price 14550.

Frontend verified in browser against the preview URL: /restaurant toggle default INR shows 3 cards ₹1,000 / ₹3,000 / ₹10,000 with 1 Year MOST POPULAR; clicking resto-currency-usd flips to $45 / $135 / $450; the resto-intl-pricing footnote mentions the opposite currency, 'Annual = 10 × monthly — 2 months free' and 'prepay 3 or 6 months'. No '…' placeholders after load. Salon landing / INR tab shows ₹1,455 / ₹4,365 / ₹14,550; International tab shows $19 + $190, $45 + $450, $139 + $1,390. HQ Billing & Subscriptions tab: derived rows render plan-derived-<key> badges ('= 3 × monthly' / '= 10 × monthly · 2 months free') for quarter, annual, resto_annual, resto_intl_quarter, resto_intl_annual, intl_pro_annual; their plan-price-<key> inputs are disabled; monthly inputs remain enabled. price-alert-card renders counts '1 international · 1 pending · 0 already notified'; clicking price-alert-preview shows the price-alert-sample iframe. competitor-watch-card renders; running competitor-watch-run updates competitor-watch-ran ('Last checked 10/3/2026 …') and both verdict boxes show 'cheapest' / 'undercut by …'. Mira Lead Agent → lead-section-history: both tables render (salon 26 leads, restaurant 4), stale-leads-card shows stale-count = 1 for QA Test Salon; stale-timeline-<id> opens stale-timeline-list-<id>; stale-delete-<id> opens a shadcn Please-confirm modal which was dismissed via Cancel — lead still present after. No resend clicked (no stale-resend-<id> rendered because that lead has no e-mail, only phone). No POST /price-alerts/send, no /resend, no deletions executed, no WhatsApp side-effects. All prices restored (monthly 1455, resto_intl_monthly 45).

action_items: Minor: In email_service price-alert sample HTML, ensure the 'Monthly' box interpolates new_monthly ($45) — currently renders blank in the HQ sample iframe. Everything else is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: services.plans.apply_derived_prices mutates catalog in place and returns None — the function signature typed as '-> None' is correct; any caller doing `x = apply_derived_prices(c)` will get None (I handled that in the unit test). Consider returning catalog for ergonomic chaining in future.

stale-delete uses a custom shadcn Please-confirm modal, NOT window.confirm — tests that register page.on('dialog') to intercept it will silently miss and risk real deletion in a less-safe environment. The modal defaults the primary action to Confirm; recommend swapping default focus to Cancel for destructive confirms.

HQ 'competitor-verdict-restaurant' says 'undercut by Square for Restaurants at $30'. Verdicts are correct given live-scrape prices, but the restaurant 'our_monthly $45' may want a copy change if positioning is premium — product decision, not a bug.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Spec fully verified. Run: `set -a; source /app/backend/.env; set +a; PYTHONPATH=/app/backend:/app/backend/tests pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter212_derived_pricing_intel.py -v -o addopts=""`. The pytest.ini addopts enable xdist which can interleave sessions; the -o addopts="" override serializes them (needed because test_put_monthly_propagates_then_restore and test_put_resto_intl_monthly_propagates_then_restore mutate shared catalog state). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must come from /app/frontend/.env (loaded explicitly in the test). The HQ stale-delete flow uses a shadcn modal, not window.confirm — pass force=True and click the Cancel button; registering page.on('dialog') will NOT fire.
